# clio hygiene clean

(or --file - for stdin; without --confirm, or with --dry-run: zero-write dry-run only)

## Usage

```
clio hygiene clean --file candidates.json [--action flag|archive|discard|apply_suggested] [--confirm] [--dry-run] [--reason R] [--note N] [--bank BANK] [--output json|text]
clio hygiene clean --file - (reads the candidates JSON from stdin)
```

## Description

without --confirm (or with --dry-run) the call is a zero-write dry-run: counts only

--action apply_suggested applies each candidate's suggested action, including archive or discard; a candidate suggested as keep is skipped

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--file candidates.json` | text |  | `cli_write_hygiene` reads it. |
| `--action flag\|archive\|discard\|apply_suggested` | enum: flag, archive, discard, delete, apply_suggested | `apply_suggested` | Sets the action per candidate (`flag`, `archive`, `discard`, `delete`, `apply_suggested`); defaults to `apply_suggested`. |
| `--confirm` |  |  | `hygiene_clean` applies the batch. |
| `--dry-run` |  |  | `hygiene_clean` previews instead. |
| `--reason R` | text |  | `hygiene_clean` forwards it. |
| `--note N` | text |  | `hygiene_clean` forwards it. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio hygiene clean --file candidates.json --dry-run --db ./memory.db
```

```
clio hygiene clean --file candidates.json --confirm --action apply_suggested
```

```
clio hygiene clean --file candidates.json --action flag --note "weak item" --bank work
```
